description.value: The Best Western Peace Arch Inn is a three-storey hotel on King George Boulevard in South Surrey, situated close to the Peace Arch Canada-US border crossing — a natural overnight stop for cyclists doing a cross-border tour. The property sits within a short ride of White Rock Beach, Crescent Beach, and Semiahmoo Bay, offering easy access to the White Rock Promenade and the coastal scenery of the Semiahmoo Peninsula.
